As of December 2025, the Tesla Model 3 is offered in Germany in four variants, with prices including VAT (19% German VAT):

| Variant | Price in Germany (incl. VAT) |
|---|---|
| **Model 3 Standard** (new entry-level, launched 05.12.2025) | **€36,990** |
| Model 3 Premium / Long Range (Rear-Wheel Drive) | €44,990 |
| Model 3 Long Range (All-Wheel Drive) | €49,990 |
| Model 3 Performance | €58,490 |

**Key context:**
- On **5 December 2025**, Tesla launched the new **Model 3 "Standard"** in Europe at **€36,990** — about €3,000 below the previous base model. It offers 534 km WLTP range, 0–100 km/h in 6.2 seconds, and a reduced feature set (no panoramic glass roof, no rear-seat heating, no rear infotainment display, etc.). First deliveries are expected from **February 2026**.
- The previous base "Premium" RWD model remains at €44,990; the AWD Long Range at €49,990; the Performance at €58,490.
- All prices include VAT and are for the German market.

**Sources:**
1. Tesla Germany – Model 3 configurator (official price authority): https://www.tesla.com/de_de/model3/design
2. CHIP.de (05.12.2025): "3.000 Euro billiger: Tesla speckt das Basis-Model-3 ab" – https://www.chip.de/news/auto-fahrrad/3-000-euro-billiger-tesla-speckt-das-basis-model-3-ab_e5c7d5ff-2c40-4c41-856a-4c32eea6d2d6.html
3. insideTesla (05.12.2025): "Ab 36.990 €: Tesla Model 3 Standard jetzt in Europa erhältlich" – https://insidetesla.de/ab-36990-tesla-model-3-standard-jetzt-in-europa/
4. model3.info – Tesla Model 3 Preisrechner (German market, 2025): https://www.model3.info/de/preisrechner
5. autocolumn.com – Tesla Model 3 Highland 2026 Kaufberatung: https://www.autocolumn.com/e-auto-nachrichten/tesla-model-3-highland-2026-kaufberatung-standard-long-range-performance/

**Caveat:** Tesla adjusts its prices frequently, and the official Tesla configurator page blocks automated access (HTTP 403), so these figures are corroborated by multiple independent sources as of December 2025. For a binding, up-to-the-minute price, check the official German configurator directly at tesla.com/de_de/model3/design.
